neighbours.label: describing a place's climate, on the adjective (a mild, wet climate; an equable climate; a subtropical arid climate), as opposed to the same frames with other nouns and ' mild' for people
fire: Northern Spain is a region with a mild, rainy climate.
Portugal has a temperate climate thanks to the ocean.
The coast of Chile enjoys a relatively cool climate.
Cairo has a hot desert climate.
Southern Japan has a warm, humid climate all year.
Its main attractions are a sunny climate and long beaches.
Madagascar has a tropical climate along the coast.
Winters in this oceanic climate are short and wet.
quiet: Northern Spain is a region with a rich, proud history.
Portugal has a long coast thanks to the ocean.
The coast of Chile enjoys a relatively large fleet.
Cairo has a famous old museum.
Southern Japan has a fast, modern railway all year.
Its main attractions are an old fort and long hikes.
My uncle was a mild, shy man in the shop.
Winters in this small village are short and quiet.

notes: ' a' before the adjective fires on its own ('with a large, old castle' 0.54 in a probe, 'has a long history' 0.33), so near misses may fail.
